lcc_original: 上帝稱穹蒼爲天：有晚上有早晨，是第二日。
notes: 上帝 (LCC) ↔ 神 (UNV): both = אֱלֹהִים WH0430; systematic lexical difference between versions
穹蒼 (LCC) ↔ 空氣 (UNV): both = רָקִיעַ WH07549 (firmament/expanse); WAH09001 definite article prefix attached to 穹蒼 as in UNV
爲 left unannotated — connective particle with no Hebrew counterpart (Hebrew uses direct apposition: וַיִּקְרָא...שָׁמַיִם)
LCC omits comma between 晚上 and 有早晨 (vs UNV 有晚上，有); punctuation preserved exactly as in LCC original
